summary: Reviewed the bounded scripted controller and outbox with explicit accounting, source coverage reconciliation, durable terminal reports and solver evidence boundaries before P2 acceptance.
findings: BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes reservations. Charges and outbox entries commit together. Dispatched uncertainty never refunds a charge; stale fences retain observations only.

Initial member subprocesses receive only the frozen packet and their own fixture specification. Ingestion follows completion of all initial roles; malformed members roll back their entire proposal set.
Repairs close structural source-reference omissions only and retain initial candidates. They cannot claim the English meaning is established; absent Java/reference verification keeps reports blocked.

Fixed adapter enumeration, finite subprocess timeout, proposal and graph caps, action/round/no-progress limits and a run deadline bound local work. Source invalidation and cancellation are separate vetoes.
Solver evidence explicitly retains its domain and does not settle the legal source commitment. Java witness replay remains required by the existing comparison engine.
Crash tests and last-slot races are deterministic engineering evidence; production provider retry semantics and independent legal effectiveness remain subsequent work.
